(Japanese: '''シロガネ山修業編 《前篇》''' ''The {{tt|Mt. Shirogane|Mt. Silver}} Training Chapter (Part 1)'') is the first special chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga taking place during {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Gold}}'s training on [[Mt. Silver]]. This chapter was first published in [[Pokémon the Comic]] on June 7, 2013, and was the result of Red and [[Pika]] respectively winning the human and Pokémon sections on the 2011 Netkun popularity poll.

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Gold}} continue their [[Mt. Silver]] training.
* [[Radio Director|Hirō]] attempts to interview {{adv|Red}}, much to {{adv|Gold}}'s annoyance.
* [[Pibu]] is kidnapped by someone, who proceeds to knock the wind out of {{adv|Gold}}.
* {{adv|Red}} and [[Pika]] attempt to rescue [[Pibu]].
* The attackers are revealed to be a wild {{p|Poliwrath}} and {{p|Venusaur}}.
